noTeacher.title: Your teacher record is not set up yet
noTeacher.body: Your account is not linked to a teacher record, so there are no classes, students, lesson plans or sessions to show. Ask your programme administrator to link your account to your teacher record.

progress.title: Student progress
progress.intro: How the students of your classes are getting on: attendance, marks and sessions held. Only your own sessions and tests are counted.
progress.howTitle: How these numbers are worked out

rule.attendance: Attendance % = the sessions a student was present or late, out of the sessions where attendance was taken. Absent and excused count as not attended. Cancelled sessions are left out.
rule.sessions: Sessions held = the sessions marked Complete or with attendance taken, out of all sessions planned. Cancelled sessions are left out.
rule.marks: Average marks is the mean of each recorded mark as a percentage of its test's total; absent and blank marks are left out.
